tei:div.tei:p: "!#ྈ yi dam dgongs 'dus rta mchog rol pa las: yi ge drug pa'i las byang gsang ba gcig 'grub ces ārya sā le'i thugs dam dril ba'i snying chos bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ thugs dam gsang ba'i lha tshogs la: rtse gcig gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: yi dam dgongs 'dus rta mchog rol pa las: yi ge drug pa'i gdams pa rta mchog rol pa'i rgyun khyer las byang gsang ba gcig 'grub bstan pa ni: e ma ho: las dang skal bar ldan pa'i gang zag la: sku gsum las byang gsang ba gcig 'grub pa: padma saṃ bha bdag gis gdams nas sbas: ma 'ongs bu yi lag tu 'byung bar shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: sngon 'gro phyir bsgyur bgegs la bka' bsgo bya: dkyil 'khor bum pa gtor tshogs rgyas par bsham: rang nyid bde ba'i gdan la skyil krung 'dug: skyabs yul sku gsum mdun du dmigs par bya: hrī: bde gshegs kun 'dus sku gsum grub pa'i lha: don gnyis mthar phyin rnams la skyabs su mchi: 'gro kun byang chub sangs rgyas thob bya'i phyir: byams dang snying rjes byang chub sems bskyed do: zhes skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya: na mo dharma kā ya: nirma kā ya: saṃ bho kā ya: ā bhe sha ya hrīng hrīng: zhes byin dbab: ma hā sarba pū tsa ga ṇa tsakra ho: mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa'o: de nas dngos gzhi ting nge 'dzin gsum ni: hrī: chos dbyings rang bzhin stong pa'i ngang nyid las: kun snang 'gro la khyab pa snying rje'i mdangs: rgyu yi ngo bo hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas: 'byung ba rim brtsegs gzhal yas bsgom pa ni: hrī: 'byung ba rim brtsegs srung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus: ye shes lnga las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang: mtshan nyid kun rdzogs dbus su pad zla'i gdan: 'gags med rang snang pad nyi dgra bgegs steng: ha ya grī wa ye shes dbang gi sku: 'bar ba'i me 'dra ye shes 'phro zhing brjid: zhal gcig khro gnyer smin 'khyugs rdzi smar bskyod: ljags 'dril mche gtsigs spyan dmar gyen du g.yo: zhal nas khrag 'dzag dbu skra dmar ser 'bar: phyag g.yas rdo rje thod dbyug dar dpyang gdengs: g.yon pas thugs kar thod pa bdud rtsis bkang:

dbu gtsug rta mgo ljang zhur 'tsher zhing rngam: thod skam dbu rgyan rlon pa'i do shal dang: stag sham glang gos sbrul chun g.yang gzhir bcas: g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang rgyan ldan gar dgur 'gying: g.yon nas 'khril ba'i rdo rje phag mo dmar: khro tshul chags bcas thod skam rin chen dang: rus pas brgyan cing gri thod yab la 'khyud: me long dril bu g.yer kha'i sgra 'khrol zhing: g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum phag zhal skra grol ba: sgyu ma 'ja' tshon chu zla lta bu'i ngang: snang stong lha sku ye shes gnyis med gsal: thugs kar padma zla steng 'od klong du: dus gsum bde gshegs kun 'dus snang mtha' yas: chags bral sku mdog padma rā ga'i mdangs: don dam zhal gcig thabs shes phyag rgya zung: mtha' gnyis mi gnas mnyam gzhag skyil krung rgya: sku ni mtha' bral gtsug tor bltar mi mngon: 'gro la mchog stsol lhung bzed bdud rtsis bkang: rnam dag khrims ldan chos gos rnam gsum gsol: bdag gzhan don rdzogs mtshan dpe ldan par bsgom: spyi bor rje btsun padma saṃ bha wa: rdo rje bhandha thabs shes phyag rgyar gsal: paṇa zhu rna ring chos gos thang sham gsol: dmar smug mdangs ldan gzi brjid 'bar bar gsal: lte bar gtum mo ye shes bde drod las: gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor gsal: rang bzhin lhun grub rtsa gsum lha yi tshogs: gdan dang phyag mtshan yongs rdzogs sku ru gsal: de nas spyan 'dren pa ni/ hrī: gnas gsum sku gsung thugs kyi yi ge ni: dkar dmar mthing gsum rdo rje gsum gyi dngos: bde gshegs ma lus 'dus pa'i 'od zer gyis: dbang chen lha tshogs 'od dpag med pa dang: gsang ba ye shes rje btsun gu ru rje: rta gdong phyag rgya'i tshul gyis spyan 'dren na: dbang gi rta skad 'tsher zhing gshegs su gsol: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: de nas bzhugs su gsol zhing phyag 'tshal ba ni: hrī: ye nas bdag dang gnyis med ye shes lha:

rang byung rang gsal ngang du brtan par bzhugs: bde gshegs sku gsum don gyi lha tshogs la: sgo gsum 'du 'bral med par phyag 'tshal lo: mchod pa ni: hrī: 'khor dang myang 'das phyi nang gsang ba yi: phyi nang gsang mchod gzugs sgra dri ro dang: reg bya chos sogs nam mkha' gang bar sprul: tshogs dang sman raka gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul: bstod pa ni: hrī: dus gsum sangs rgyas sku gsum 'dus pa'i lha: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gzhon tshul gar dgur ldan: snyan 'tsher 'ur chom gseng bag gad rgyangs can: thugs rje rgyun mi chad pa'i tshogs la bstod: bzlas pa bya ba ni: thugs kar nyi zla'i steng du hrīḥyig las: gsang sngags snying po bar med 'du zhing 'phro: bdag gzhan don byas yi ge drug ma bzla: oṃ ha ya grī wa hūm̐: grags stong so ma ma yengs bye ba bzla: rgyun du yi dam byas na lha ru 'gyur: skabs su snying po hrīḥ bzlas khyer so bya: rang lus lha la sgra grags sngags kyi sgra: dran rtog sku lnga ting 'dzin rgya mtshor gsal: de nas tshogs mchod ni: hrī: skong rdzas tshogs kyi ma dag bsregs gtor sbyangs: yi ge gsum gyis byin rlabs ye shes bskyed: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: oṃ āḥhūm̐: spyan 'dren mchod bshags bstab pa ni: hrī: ye shes lha tshogs 'dir byon tshogs la rol: rtsa gsum rgyal bas tshogs phud yar bzhes shig: zag med ga ṇa tshogs kyis bskang zhing bshags: bag chags 'khor ba'i dgra bgegs zhal du bstab: ga ṇa tsakra pū dza ho: rdo rje slob dpon la drang ba ni: hrī: rdo rje slob dpon sgrub pa'i mched dang lcam: 'dod yon ma spangs longs spyod rgyan du bzhes: lan 'debs pa ni: hrīḥho: bdag dang dbyer med rtsa gsum don gyi lha: zag med bde ba'i zhal zas tshogs su rol: ma nu sarba sa ma ya badzra tsitta hūm̐: zhes smon lam btab: de nas lhag ma bya ba ni: a kā ro mu khaṃ sogs kyi sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs la:

hrīḥbhyo: rang ngo ma shes rtog 'khyams sgrib can kun: phud dang dpal gyi pha 'bab longs spyod rol: gsang sngags bstan dgra kha yi za skal gyis: rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: oṃ utstshiṣṭa ba liṃ ta bhakṣa bhakṣā ya swā hā: bskul pa ni: hūm̐ hrī: thabs shes sgyu ma'i lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: dbyings rig ka dag rig pa'i thugs dam bskul: dug gsum dgra bgegs sku gsum klong du sgrol: ma rig rnam rtog skye med ngang du zlog: swa bhā wa phaṭa: chad mdo brtan skyong ni: hrī: thog med dus dang da lta ma 'ongs tshe: sku gsum bde gshegs spyan sngar rang mdangs 'khor: brjod bral blo 'das chos 'khor rtag bskor tshe: rig rtsal mkha' 'gro dam can khas blangs bzhin: 'khor ba ru zlog ye shes dbyings sgrol ba'i: phrin las sgrub pa'i ma mo brtan ma'i tshogs: bka' dang dam las ma 'da' sa ma ya: ma ma yo gi nī ba liṃ ta khā hi: rta bro ni: hrī: chos dbyings ye shes chen po'i mkha' dbyings su: gnyis 'dzin rtog tshogs ma lus gnon pa'i phyir: zhi khro'i gar ni 'khor 'das dbyings su sgyur: kun rdzob 'khrul pa'i gdon tshogs thal bar rlog: sarba st+wambha ya nan: bsngo ba smon lam ni: hrī: 'dus dang 'dus byas kun rdzob don dam chos: thams cad byang chub chen po'i rgyur bsngo 'o: 'khor bar gnas pa'i ma gyur sems can kun: ma lus phyam gcig sangs rgyas thob gyur cig: gshegs bsdu ni: hrī: bdag dang dam tshig ye shes gnyis med lha: nam yang mi gtong yun du bsten par bgyi: hrīḥyig ye shes lnga yi don la blta: stong gsal brjod bral rig sku mngon sum mthong: tiṣṭha badzra sa ma ya hūm̐: bkra shis ni: hrī: sku gsum ye shes mi 'gyur don gyi lha: zhi dang khro gar gsang sngags rang sgra can: thugs rje'i mkha' khyab ye shes dkyil 'khor gyis: khams gsum sems can kun la bde legs stsol:

zhes rgyas par 'dod na gzhung ltar bya: dkyil 'khor bsdu ba sogs las rjes spyi mthun bya: zhes rtsa gsum snying po gcig dril yi ge drug pa'i sgrub thabs las byang gi rim pa ārya sā le'i skye ba bdun rgyud du nyams su blangs pa'i rang chos 'di yang ma 'ongs tha ma'i dus de'i chos spyod kyi skal du sbas pa'o: zab rgya: / /: gu hya: sku rgya: gsung rgya: thugs rgya: bdag rang gi chos skal yin 'dra// //
